chunks: Ahmad ibn 'Isa narrated from Ibrahim ibn Abi Mahmud, who said:
I said to al-Rida (peace be upon him): 'Do I kiss the Yemeni, the Syrian, and the Western [stones]?' He said, 'Yes.'
ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to kiss the Yemeni, Syrian, and Western stones during Hajj?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Rida (peace be upon him) explicitly confirms the permissibility of Istilam (kissing or touching) the Yemeni, Syrian, and Western stones of the Kaaba. This ruling underscores the significance of these specific landmarks as focal points for reverence during Tawaf, distinguishing them within the ritual practice of Shia jurisprudence. The confirmation highlights the continuity of prophetic traditions regarding the physical veneration of the Kaaba's corners.
